statistics_method.false_warnings_per_30d: exact Poisson (Garwood) 95% on the count, scaled by scored UTC days
statistics_method.gating: nothing computed below the checkpoint (60 events, 25/direction) or in cells with < 20 episodes
statistics_method.incremental_hits_vs_F1: exact McNemar on discordant episodes, Holm over F2/F3/F4
statistics_method.recall: Wilson 95%, unit = evaluable episode (episodes are separated by v1.0.0 resolution)
statistics_method.vs_F0: one-sided empirical p over 1000 deterministic circular shifts
